questions.q: In standard Canadian residential wall framing, studs are typically spaced at:
questions.why: 16 in (406 mm) on centre is the standard stud spacing for conventional residential wall framing.

questions.q: What is the minimum end bearing required for a stud on a sole plate?
questions.why: The minimum end bearing for a stud on a sole plate is 19 mm (3/4 in), providing adequate support and preventing movement.

questions.q: What is the primary function of a header in a wall opening?
opts: To transfer loads above the opening
To provide a nailing surface for cladding
questions.why: A header spans the opening and transfers the load from above to the jack studs on each side.

questions.q: A roof has a slope of 6/12. Over a horizontal run of 24 in, how much does it rise?
questions.why: A 6/12 slope rises 6 in per 12 in of run: over 24 in, the rise is 12 in.
